title: Unnamed Gonzaga agent (Rome) to Gianfrancesco Gonzaga, 9 Aug 1428, Archivio di Stato di Mantova (DECODE R1854 image 2)

documents.shelfmark: Archivio di Stato di Mantova, Archivio Gonzaga (busta not given on DECODE), DECODE R1854 image 2

transcription.source: DECODE images via saved session cookie
transcription.notes: Two passes by the model at 2-5x; glyph splits (bold/dotted nabla, tailed/plain circle) found by the solver and checked in the image.

system.sibling_key: none (DECODE R1853 is the Gonzaga register of c. 1401-1420; no 1428-30 key)
system.summary: Homophonic substitution in graphic signs and digits with about a dozen nulls, syllable signs for con, et and -rum, and two word codes (ARW = cardinalis).
system.notes: Bold nabla = s, thin dotted nabla = null; tailed circle = p, plain circle = h. Split 14 Oct 2026: the other three letters of the record are malatesta1428, mutiliana1428, cattanei1430.

prior_solution.where: DECODE status 'Partially decrypted' (for the record) with no transcription; nothing for image 2

conditions.human_role: Project-level: DECODE login cookie and /goal target setting. No target-specific intervention.
tools: targets/r1854/solve.py homophonic annealer on lang/ models

solution.what: Fetched R1854 (5 images), the R1853 register (14 images) and DECODE metadata with the saved cookie.
Viewed the five images: four letters to Gianfrancesco Gonzaga (Rome 22 Apr and 9 Aug 1428, Forli 6 Nov 1428, Rome 13/21 Feb 1430); image 2 is the unnamed agent's letter of 9 Aug 1428.
Read the R1853 register keys (Malatesta keys on f. 1, 1406-1419 keys): none match the 1428-30 letters.
Opened all other Mantova records on DECODE (R7858-R7888): 16th-17th century keys.
First-pass sign transcription of P2 (37 lines) by the model.
P2: IC 0.040, 46 sign types -> homophonic; the triangle precedes sign 17 in 21 of 29 cases -> q/u.
Homophonic anneal on P2 with the Latin model and q/u fixed: Latin words appear (quod, predicto, ibidem, filium).
P2 second pass at 5x separating look-alike glyphs.
Per-sign and per-occurrence rescoring of P2 finds nulls, the bold/dotted nabla split (s/null) and con/et/rum signs; P2 reads as continuous Latin.

Push to 95%: the five DECODE images re-fetched with the saved cookie (PNG, P1 1121x697 px) into img/ (git-ignored); P1 run lines, P2 L15/L28 and P4 L04/L20 cropped at 3-4x and compared with p1v2/p2v3/p4v2. P1 L05 confirms the second-pass signs; P4 L04 'leonebi' (t + = e b) cannot be read as 'Leonelli' from the image; P2 L28 confirms '= 14 j 14 P w 7 &' (l e u e n d e r).
P2 L28 read from the existing key: 'persuaserat matri et filie u[t] vel(l)e(nt) vendere ter(r)as ipsas' (17 signs; was 'vellent venire(?) [?] ipsas').

Split from the R1854 entry under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): the record's four letters use four ciphers; this entry keeps image 2. Re-count from the 5 Oct 2026 figures: 1,757 of 1,802 signs read as sense (0.975).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1781 tokens, 51 types, la order 4: reading -2.122 per letter; random keys -4.721 (z 7.5); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.037 (mean -3.071, z 40.1); annealer on the real text -2.145. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.122; polyphony 0.0; 26 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.145

outcome.method_basis: The homophonic key was recovered by annealing on the shared Latin model after q and u were fixed from contact (the triangle precedes sign 17 in 21 of 29 cases), then nulls and look-alike glyphs separated by per-sign and per-occurrence rescoring and checked on the image.
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_p2.md: 1,757 of 1,802 cipher signs (ct_p2.txt, measured with _check_profile.py) read as sense; doubtful spans hand-counted, re-counted 5 Oct 2026.

gaps.item: code ARO (1x, 'in filium [ARO]') and about 45 signs in doubtful spans (L15, L27, L31-32)
gaps.detail: single occurrences; no sibling letter in this cipher

outcome.notes: Split 14 Oct 2026 from the four-letter R1854 entry; the pooled validation of 11 Oct 2026 was re-run on this key alone.
